title: Tests of Windows path handling plant a directory separator
goal: Every test that proves a Windows path fix plants a path with at least one directory below its root, so a native backslash separator is exercised: the git revision reads (factdiff, kbgit), kbingest's worktree masking and link checks, and the raw-read hint's path parsing. Failure it answers (SP-76inhw33 retrospective): TK-6pi2udtb's test planted the snapshot at the repository root, so old_passage's backslash path on Windows passed its check (BG-anhc7w55).
